@tbl-cyclones-data records the number of tropical cyclones
in northeastern Australia
during 13 November-to-April cyclone seasons,
from 1956/57 to 1968/69 [@dobson4e, Section 1.6.5].
@fig-dobson-cyclone-time-series graphs
the number of cyclones by season.
Let $X_i$ represent the number of cyclones in season $i$,
and $x_i$ its observed value.

::: {#tbl-cyclones-data}

```{r}
cyclones <- tibble::tibble(
  years = c(
    "1956/7", "1957/8", "1958/9", "1959/60", "1960/1", "1961/2", "1962/3",
    "1963/4", "1964/5", "1965/6", "1966/7", "1967/8", "1968/9"
  ),
  season = 1:13,
  number = c(6, 5, 4, 6, 6, 3, 12, 7, 4, 2, 6, 7, 4)
)
cyclones |> knitr::kable()
```

Number of tropical cyclones during each November-to-April season
in northeastern Australia [@dobson4e, Section 1.6.5]

:::
